parsed.name: 串口通信助手组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非实体的软件组件，用于在实验系统中统一管理串口连接。它提供串口名标准化、打开与关闭端口、读写数据包、按终止符读取、缓冲区清理以及端口参数查询等功能，便于各类基于串口通信的实验仪器接入。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used to standardize serial communication in a lab system. It provides port-name normalization, port open/close control, packet read/write, terminator-based reads, buffer clearing, and serial parameter queries, helping integrate various serial-connected laboratory instruments.
